annotations.title: Melt value and scrap gold calculator

description: Melt (intrinsic metal) value of any gold, silver or platinum item or scrap jewelry at live spot: weight x purity (or gold karat) x spot. Supports troy oz, grams, kilograms and pennyweight, plus an optional buyer offer comparison (% of melt and below-spot warning). Standard tool free; for a version fine-tuned or customized to your business, email for pricing via https://bullionpricecheck.com/contact/.

karat.description: Gold karat for scrap gold or jewelry (e.g. 10, 14, 18, 22, 24 where 24k=0.999). Use instead of purity.

metal.description: Metal (defaults to gold when karat is given). Palladium is not tracked.

offer_usd.description: Optional buyer offer in USD to compare against full melt value (returns pct_of_melt).

purity.description: Metal fineness as a fraction (0-1), e.g. 0.999, 0.9167 (22k), 0.925 (sterling), 0.90 (90% coin silver). Defaults to 1 when karat is omitted.

unit.description: Weight unit: ozt = troy ounce (default for bullion), g = gram (default when karat is given), kg = kilogram, dwt = pennyweight.

weight.description: Gross weight of the item or scrap lot.
